sourceDescription: Formal overall phase/release counts from the existing private 16-sheet master workbook (unchanged); Phase 8.32 milestone and regression evidence from independently verified GitHub seal. Private workbook binary update pending.

scoring.architecture: Strict completed architecture phases / all v1 phases. No partial credit.
scoring.capability: Provisional evidence-based 0–4 maturity scores, weighted equally by the five development pillars. Model and per-capability evidence are publicly inspectable; legacy percentages are retired.
scoring.pillars: Each planned phase assigned to exactly one dashboard pillar for display; counts measure phase closure, not capability readiness.

tests.scope: Authoritative Windows full regression, Phase 8.32 pre-stage, staged and postcommit; 2,617 passed each

security.review: Independent GPT-6.1 Sol High full-source and staged-delta review completed
security.result: GO for bounded Phase 8.32 engineering scope; not consumer-release acceptance

phases.name: Reference Freeze
phases.summary: Protect the validated Mark baseline and isolate Nayeon development.

phases.name: Environment Foundation
phases.summary: Make the local runtime deterministic and safe to configure.

phases.name: AI Service / Provider Abstraction
phases.summary: Keep reasoning provider-neutral while using OpenAI first.

phases.name: Trusted Agent Runtime & Generic Orchestration
phases.summary: Provide the reusable agent execution spine for many capabilities.

phases.name: Policy, Safety & Verification
phases.summary: Keep machine actions behind explicit, testable trust controls.

phases.name: Filesystem
phases.summary: Build safe local file capabilities incrementally.

phases.name: Computer Control
phases.summary: Add bounded desktop/window observation and later keyboard/mouse/window controls behind the same trust boundary.

phases.name: User Identity & Configuration
phases.summary: Make the assistant identity and user presentation preferences configurable without allowing presentation identity to become trusted action/security identity.

phases.name: Secure Secrets & BYOK Onboarding
phases.summary: Turn the provider connection into a consumer-safe first-run flow.

phases.name: Memory
phases.summary: Add useful context retention with explicit local/privacy boundaries.

phases.name: Vision / Perception
phases.summary: Let Nayeon observe visual state independently of any single model provider.

phases.name: Browser
phases.summary: Support controlled web interaction through the same agent loop.

phases.name: Voice
phases.summary: Turn the runtime into a natural conversational assistant with bounded speaker awareness.

phases.name: Events & Proactive
phases.summary: Enable bounded initiative without notification spam or hidden autonomy.

phases.name: Specialist Services & Integrations
phases.summary: Expand breadth only on the stable common contracts.

phases.name: Desktop Runtime & UI
phases.summary: Expose Nayeon as a normal Windows product rather than a developer workspace.

phases.name: Security & Compliance Release Readiness
phases.summary: Apply cross-cutting security/privacy gates before broader distribution.

phases.name: Packaging, Signing & Updates
phases.summary: Ship a trusted installable Windows application.

phases.name: Autonomy
phases.summary: Add multi-step goal pursuit only after individual capabilities are dependable.

capabilities.name: OpenApp reference
capabilities.detail: A scoped reference demonstration exists; it is not a general-purpose installed assistant.

capabilities.name: Trusted Core
capabilities.detail: Trusted orchestration foundations are built and tested; user-facing integration is incomplete.

capabilities.name: Filesystem
capabilities.detail: A bounded first version of file actions was completed; broader file management remains outside this scope.

capabilities.name: Security & compliance
capabilities.detail: Independent engineering reviews are ongoing. Formal release assurance is not complete.

capabilities.name: Computer control
capabilities.detail: A bounded first version passed its phase exit tests; general desktop autonomy is not claimed.

capabilities.name: Secure BYOK
capabilities.detail: Secure setup foundations and offline tests exist; real-user provider onboarding is not release-accepted.

capabilities.name: Memory
capabilities.detail: Persistent personal memory has not completed its planned implementation phase.

capabilities.name: Voice
capabilities.detail: A natural voice interaction workflow has not completed its planned phase.

capabilities.name: Assistant identity & configuration
capabilities.detail: Identity and preference contracts were completed; consumer onboarding remains incomplete.

capabilities.name: Vision
capabilities.detail: The perception and privacy-controlled vision phase has not started.

capabilities.name: Browser
capabilities.detail: Controlled browser task execution has not started.

capabilities.name: Proactive events
capabilities.detail: A user-controlled proactive event experience has not started.

capabilities.name: Desktop UI
capabilities.detail: Offline Tk workspace milestones 8.30–8.31 are closed, but a production installed desktop app is not yet accepted.

capabilities.name: Autonomy
capabilities.detail: Autonomous multi-step goal execution has not started.

capabilities.name: Packaging & installer
capabilities.detail: A signed, clean-device installer and update system are not yet accepted.

capabilities.name: Commercial backend
capabilities.detail: Optional future commercial service; not part of the 19-phase v1 denominator.

gates.name: Installed desktop app starts without Python/Git/VS Code
Guided assistant identity and permissions onboarding works
BYOK key can be entered, securely stored, replaced and deleted
Provider key can be explicitly validated with safe status display
Normal GUI chat starts, continues, cancels conversations
User can review and approve a sensitive local action in the GUI
GUI request → action → observed verification end-to-end
Microphone + TTS conversation and interruption workflow
Screen/camera observation workflow has privacy controls
User-controlled persistent memory and bounded proactive events
Signed clean-device installer and tested update/rollback

milestones.name: Phase 8.29
milestones.detail: Bounded first-run offline acceptance milestone sealed and remotely verified.

milestones.name: Phase 8.30
milestones.detail: Offline Windows workspace milestone closed; consumer packaging still pending.

milestones.name: Phase 8.31
milestones.detail: Trusted, bounded offline conversation session milestone sealed and independently reviewed.

milestones.name: Phase 8.32
milestones.detail: Offline reset lifecycle assurance, user-accepted lazy expiry, stale-review ownership and thread-first callback checks. GitHub commit/tag and three full native regressions verified; no live model or consumer release claim.

disclosure: Publicly approved summary of project status only. Original workbook, internal tests, credential information and protected engineering evidence are excluded.

capabilityMaturity.classification: Analyst-scored engineering capability maturity, NOT independent end-user release acceptance
capabilityMaturity.inclusion: 15 required BYOK v1 capabilities (one optional future commercial backend excluded)
capabilityMaturity.weighting: Each of the five named pillars contributes exactly 20%; within a pillar included capabilities contribute equally; each rating has a maximum of 4.

levelDefinitions.label: No qualifying implementation
levelDefinitions.requiredEvidence: No verified implemented capability. Planned design or legacy estimate alone does not earn points.

levelDefinitions.label: Isolated, synthetic or contract foundation
levelDefinitions.requiredEvidence: Independently reviewed tested contract, prototype or fake-only/offline slice; not a verified normal-user task.

levelDefinitions.label: Verified bounded local workflow
levelDefinitions.requiredEvidence: A constrained real-Windows capability or interface workflow is implemented, regression-tested and independently reviewed; full integration not implied.

levelDefinitions.label: Integrated pre-release user journey
levelDefinitions.requiredEvidence: A complete real-user Windows application journey is demonstrated across capability boundaries with non-simulated dependencies and independently verified.

levelDefinitions.label: End-user accepted
levelDefinitions.requiredEvidence: Required normal-user acceptance scenarios pass on a clean installed device, with independent acceptance evidence.

openapp-reference.evidence: Bounded OpenApp reference behavior was demonstrated and sealed.
openapp-reference.limitation: Not a packaged, broadly available assistant action.

trusted-core.evidence: Tested generic intent-routing, permission and session foundations support bounded workflows.
trusted-core.limitation: No normal consumer AI journey accepted.

filesystem.evidence: Phase 5 closed after bounded file actions and Windows validation.
filesystem.limitation: Rename, move, trash, recursive flows and end-user UI are not covered.

security---compliance.evidence: Independent high-effort source and staged security review of bounded Phase 8.32, with historical trust controls and Git seals preserved.
security---compliance.limitation: Full release assurance or certification is not complete.
security---compliance.workbookReferences: Capability Review!E9; Phase Evidence!F22; Phase 8.31 review

computer-control.evidence: Phase 6 closed after bounded real Windows computer-control testing.
computer-control.limitation: General GUI automation and normal-user integration are not accepted.

secure-byok.evidence: Sealed, independently reviewed fake-only Tk credential and recovery test foundation.
secure-byok.limitation: No live consumer credential handling or provider validation is accepted.
secure-byok.workbookReferences: Capability Review!E11; Release Gates!D8:D9; Implementation Progress!A156:H156

memory.evidence: No qualifying persistent personal memory workflow is evidenced.

voice.evidence: No working end-to-end voice workflow is evidenced.

assistant-identity---config.evidence: Typed identity/preferences contracts and bounded offline presentation settings are tested.
assistant-identity---config.limitation: No accepted first-run identity and permissions onboarding.
assistant-identity---config.workbookReferences: Capability Review!E14; Phase Evidence!D13; Release Gates!C7

vision.evidence: No verified v1 screen/camera perception workflow.

browser.evidence: No verified v1 controlled browser inspect/act/verify workflow.

proactive---events.evidence: No verified bounded proactive event workflow.

desktop-ui.evidence: Independently reviewed and regression-tested Phase 8.30–8.32 offline Windows Tk workspace, ephemeral conversation and bounded reset lifecycle.
desktop-ui.limitation: Offline only: no integrated live AI chat, installed consumer client or acceptance gate.
desktop-ui.workbookReferences: Capability Review!E18; Implementation Progress!A158:H159; verified Phase 8.32 Git seal; Release Gates!C6/C10

autonomy.evidence: No verified multi-step policy-aware autonomous task delivery.

packaging---installer.evidence: No verified signed installer, clean-device start or update/rollback.

warnings: Provisional, analyst-defined measurement; the rubric and judgments are inspectable but have not been signed off as formal independent product assurance.
A level 2 rating describes bounded evidence, not 50% of a capability's total engineering effort or user-facing features.
The 0/12 release-gates count is a separate strict measure. No capability has a level 3 or 4 rating in this snapshot.
Desktop UI has a bounded Phases 8.30–8.32 offline-workspace exception despite formal Phase 15 NOT STARTED; that phase's release exit remains open.
No partial credit for design-only, unverified or optional future commercial work.
capabilityMaturity.evidenceSource: Formal architecture/release status from existing private 16-sheet master workbook; verified Git seals through Phase 8.32 (the private workbook binary has not yet been synchronised).
